info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Severitys-v2-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Severity API facilitates access to critical weather alert information, allowing users to stay informed about weather severity levels in real-time. This API provides a comprehensive list of weather alerts, detailing their severity classifications and associated details. Typical consumers include emergency management agencies, meteorological services, and applications that provide weather-related notifications to users. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their applications with relevant weather alert data to ensure public safety and preparedness.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the different severity levels of alerts currently available in the system, helping you to categorize and prioritize alerts effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the criteria for retrieving alerts based on their severity level. The payload should include the necessary parameters to filter alerts accurately.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing and will be completed asynchronously.

ListWeatherAlertsSeveritysRequest.description: This schema represents the severity level of alerts.

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the request.

state.description: The current state of the alert.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the request's outcome.

audit.description: Audit information related to the request.

ListWeatherAlertsSeveritysResponse_202.description: Response schema for the severity alerts operation.

createdBy.description: The user who created the alert.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the alert was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the alert was generated automatically.

Audit.description: Contains information regarding the creation and automation of the alert.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 signifies the request was processed nearly instantaneously.
